description: This file defines the IGrainContext interface and related extension and internal interfaces for the Orleans runtime, providing abstractions for grain lifecycle management, messaging, activation, deactivation, and extension handling.

classes.name: GrainContextExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for IGrainContext, including an obsolete method for deactivation.

classes.name: ICollectibleGrainContext
classes.description: Internal interface extending IGrainContext, adding properties and methods for activation collection and lifecycle management.

methods.name: DeactivateAsync
methods.description: Obsolete extension method to deactivate a grain asynchronously, waiting for deactivation to complete.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Sets a component of a specified type within the grain context.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Submits an incoming message to the grain instance.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Starts activating the grain with optional request context and cancellation token.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Starts deactivating the grain with a specified reason and optional cancellation token.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Rehydrates the grain from a provided context.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Attempts to migrate the grain to another location, capturing current request context.

methods.name: IsStale
methods.description: Determines if the activation has been idle longer than its collection age limit.

methods.name: GetIdleness
methods.description: Returns the duration the activation has been idle.

methods.name: DelayDeactivation
methods.description: Delays the deactivation of the activation for a specified timespan.
